name: Bonzi Buddy
description: The current Bonzi gorilla design with classic talking, paper-reading/look-up and sunglasses-wave gestures.
generation: Built-in OpenAI image generation with a canonical identity reference and separate grounded strips; deterministic extraction, shared registration, composition and edge cleanup.
limitations: Generated recreation, not original animation frames.
Near-down-left horizontal cue is subtle; direction checks retain a reviewed warning.
Original voice and desktop routines are not included.
Classic gestures are adapted to the fixed pet animation slots; the GIFs’ vine entrance, full sequences and audio are not included.
repository_revision: Second look-row source uses scale 1.14 to preserve top padding.

web.notes: Same first nine animation rows; sixteen directional look frames are exclusive to v2.
